notes.title: Memories: Millennium Girl 1.1.3 Version Update
notes.content:
<Update Notes>

- The balance related to endings has been adjusted. You can now experience endings linked to the progression of education and event triggers.

- Optimization and performance speed have been improved. Issues where the game wouldn't run on certain graphic cards have been resolved.

- New story content has been added. Discover the newly hidden storyline!

- Trigger conditions for certain events have been adjusted, making it easier to encounter more events.

notes.title: Verbena Festival Held!
notes.content:
[b]Verbena Festival Held![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/4635af42b4f672697d2f59d8967aea068cb7f763.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/5d6d3af2aa27497c698ea5ad4965e6ea4292a826.png[/img]
Maribel: Hello, I'm Maribel, the daily reporter!You've been waiting for a long time. Finally, the Verbena Festival has opened, and the atmosphere of the festival is said to be very lively, just as we've been waiting for so long.It's said that the Verbena Festival is held every August. Now, let's go check out the festival!


[b][Battle Bloom Blitz][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/2ca06c2eebfb542197c9477b55e2e2456bdfd89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/5d6d3af2aa27497c698ea5ad4965e6ea4292a826.png[/img]
Maribel: Hey, feeling the heat from the crowd and the players' passion here! Let's get the scoop on what's going on.
Excuse me, Princess Olivia? What is this place for?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/2bc2a277712a36243373f9b6e6295298c0c7dbc5.png[/img]
Olivia: Hmph. This is the Colosseum Arena where the main event of the Verbena Festival, the [Battle Bloom Blitz] tournament, takes place. It's a competition held in tournament format to select the best warriors of the Verbena Kingdom in this arena.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/2bc2a277712a36243373f9b6e6295298c0c7dbc5.png[/img]
Olivia: Many diverse and numerous warriors participate, delighting the eyes and ears of the audience. If it's your first time seeing it, you can truly be proud of the enjoyment you'll experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/5d6d3af2aa27497c698ea5ad4965e6ea4292a826.png[/img]
Maribel: Oh, just hearing about it makes my heart race; it seems like it will be an exciting competition. Anyway, you mentioned selecting the best warrior from the Kingdom of Verbena. What are the participation conditions, Princess Olivia?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/2bc2a277712a36243373f9b6e6295298c0c7dbc5.png[/img]
Olivia: The participation conditions are simple. Anyone from Verbena who wants to participate can do so. So, those who wish to participate should not be afraid and feel free to join, no matter who you are.?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/5d6d3af2aa27497c698ea5ad4965e6ea4292a826.png[/img]
Maribel: Haha, I see. In that case, Mr. Jeffrey, could you share some tips for achieving success in "Battle Bloom Blitz"?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/f259130fb0120031fd745c4911c42c11bb8d9c43.png[/img]
Jeffrey: Of course! You have to go back to the basics. Strengthen your stamina and physical strength to increase HP, and also enhance your knowledge and skills to boost MP.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/f259130fb0120031fd745c4911c42c11bb8d9c43.png[/img]
Jeffrey: Also, keep in mind that those with high strength and warrior evaluations tend to have high defense and magical defense. Is there anything more to add than this?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/5d6d3af2aa27497c698ea5ad4965e6ea4292a826.png[/img]
Maribel: Thank you for the great tips! Next, let's take a look at the [Artistry Auction Affair] competition


[b][Artistry Auction Affair][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/2f15277e6d4d6a520053c11895238ef8377ba031.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/8cfce853b3e750e8e9221a049d293c9a5cfa2606.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/5d6d3af2aa27497c698ea5ad4965e6ea4292a826.png[/img]
Maribel:This is indeed a calmly atmospheric tournament venue. What's unique is that the venue is divided into two places One place seems to be for drawing, and the other is an auction hall, right? Sofia, could you introduce yourself and explain a bit?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/a544fb72a13c600b15f19939d1cc5d1008dccb50.png[/img]
Sophia: Hello. I'm Sophia, the host of the [Artistry Auction Affair] competition. The reason it is divided into two locations is due to the unique feature of the "[Artistry Auction Affair]" competition, which involves creating artworks and auctioning them. It's not just about drawing and comparing pictures; participants need to explain and appeal their artwork to the auctioneers, who then bid for the prize money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/5d6d3af2aa27497c698ea5ad4965e6ea4292a826.png[/img]
Maribel: I see. It's a remarkably unique competition. Do you have any tips for achieving success in the competition?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/a544fb72a13c600b15f19939d1cc5d1008dccb50.png[/img]
Sophia: Of course. Obviously, you have to draw well, which is the key to the competition, and people with high artistry, art appreciation, and sensitivity usually draw well, and as I said, there's also a time before the auction to sell your work, and I've seen people who don't draw well, but have high verbal skills, social skills, and good taste, sell their work well and get a lot of money at the auction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/a544fb72a13c600b15f19939d1cc5d1008dccb50.png[/img]
Sophia: And for you Maribel, they told me that there are a total of 65 different drawings that you can do, depending on your level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/7fa0e055745ecd71ea81b0f589513a401e129db5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/5d6d3af2aa27497c698ea5ad4965e6ea4292a826.png[/img]
Maribel: Hoho, it's a bit embarrassing. Well, it must be a delightful little pleasure to see what kind of picture comes out every time you draw.
Thank you for the great tips!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/5d6d3af2aa27497c698ea5ad4965e6ea4292a826.png[/img]
Maribel: Next, let's delve into the [Taste Triumph Tussle] competition.


[b][Taste Triumph Tussle][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/3d64843408d6a4fc78857fe4b38261f4d5e6579a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/5d6d3af2aa27497c698ea5ad4965e6ea4292a826.png[/img]
Maribel: This is the venue for the [Taste Triumph Tussle.]
Can I ask you to introduce yourself to the [Taste Triumph Tussle], Mr. Kayle?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/a8ad7d309999cc528d40dd5b7463a1d5bdea192f.png[/img]
Kayle: Sure. Hi, I'm Kayle, and I'm the host of [Taste Triumph Tussle]. [Taste Triumph Tussle] is a competition where Verbena's chefs come together to see who's the best.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/a8ad7d309999cc528d40dd5b7463a1d5bdea192f.png[/img]
Kayle: In [Taste Triumph Tussle], the ability to cook is the most important thing, but hygiene is just as important as cooking. Cleanliness is also one of the criteria. Generally speaking, people who have high household skills and high household ratings score well on cleanliness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/a8ad7d309999cc528d40dd5b7463a1d5bdea192f.png[/img]
Kayle: It's also fun to watch the judges' faces, so I would definitely encourage you to participate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487285/5d6d3af2aa27497c698ea5ad4965e6ea4292a826.png[/img]
Maribel: Great, thanks for the tip, Kayle!
Now, are you ready to enjoy the Verbena Festival? Come on, let's go enjoy the festivities!


[b]Additional Development[/b]

1. A skip button, available after the first reincarnation, has been added for convenience.
2. A time capsule item has been introduced, allowing players to instantly jump to December of 18 years old while maintaining the current status.
3. Some ending conditions have been adjusted downward.

notes.title: Memories: Millennium Girl 1.0.36 Version Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]ꉂ☻ᵎᵎᵎ Hey, my dear brothers and sisters! 
I've made something special so we can have even more fun together! 
Come take a look, hehe. [/b]

[Content Addition]

1. A total of 130 teaser events and light events for the story and existing events have been added.
2. A bulletin board has been added to the village, providing a total of 76 pieces of information that can be checked every month.

[Feature Addition]

1. A UI displaying the monster's name and HP when attacking a monster is now available.

[Event Balance and Bug Fixes]

1. Events that were not linked during the event have been fixed.
2. The activation conditions for the Charmant Social Event have been lowered.
3. The conditions for the Revolutionary Army Leader ending have been lowered.
4. The combat power of NPCs encountered in adventure areas has been slightly lowered.

[Other Changes]

1. About 20 new cutscenes have been added to the endings and events.
2. The Companionship Book for NPCs who have seen the social ending will now be permanently open.

[b]Love you all, MUAH! 😘💋💋[/b]

(1) Spring dress
(2) Summer dress
(3) Autumn sweater

[b][Social Balance Adjustment][/b]

[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
1. Unnatural dialogue sequences in some events have been corrected.
(1) Events related to the black magician
(2) Charmant social events
2. Fixed the issue where the 4th social event for Barea was not appearing correctly.
3. Corrected the issue where martial arts-related content was not appearing in the letter ending.

[b][Other Changes][/b]

notes.title: Memories: Millennium Girl 1.0.32 Version Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]ꉂ☻ᵎᵎᵎ Hey, my dear brothers and sisters! 
I've made something special so we can have even more fun together! 
Come take a look, hehe. [/b]

[Event-Related Balance Adjustments]
1. We have lowered the activation conditions for specific events in adventure areas.
2. The rewards for events related to certain skills have been increased.

[Job Ending Balance Adjustments]
1. The overall point value for job endings has been increased.
2. We have slightly raised the difficulty for the conditions of private ending.

[Bug Fixes]
1. Fixed an issue where some achievements were not being completed.
2. Fixed an issue where sound was not being applied in some dialogues.
3. Corrected awkward transitions in Jack's social interactions.
4. Fixed an issue in the companionship book where birthdays were listed twice.

[Other Changes]
1. Now, when using an item in the inventory that changes your character's state, the character's motion will immediately reflect the new state.
2. The UI for the "Companionship Book" that can be accessed in the town has been updated.
3. Added a feature to complete missing job-ending achievements in the "Album View" menu on the title screen.

[b]Love you all, MUAH! 😘💋💋[/b]

notes.title: Memories: Millennium Girl 1.0.30.ver Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]ꉂ☻ᵎᵎᵎ Hey, my dear brothers and sisters! 
I've made something special so we can have even more fun together! 
Come take a look, hehe. [/b]

[b][Event-related Balance Adjustments][/b]

1. Fortune Cookie Event
   - Reduced the required amount of gold.
   - Decreased the stat reduction if you get a 'miss.'

2. Flower Watching Event
   - Increased the chances of it occurring.
   - Removed the cooking stat increase and gold decrease from rewards.

3. Cold Winter Event
   - Slightly increased the probability of this event occurring.
   - Increased the fatigue reduction amount.

4. Summer Vacation Event
   - Removed the gold requirement.

5. Ice Cream Event
   - Reduced the gold requirement.

6. Fortune Teller Event
   - Reduced the gold requirement.

[b][Schedule Balance Changes][/b]

1. Reduced the amount of stat reduction in most schedules.
2. Increased the energy consumption reduction when learning theology.

[b][Bug Fixes][/b]

1. Fixed an issue where a black screen appeared on some devices.
2. Fixed an issue where interactions in the village were not working.
3. Fixed an issue where conversations with your younger sister were not progressing.
4. Fixed an issue where some sound effects were not playing.
5. Fixed some awkward scripts.

[b][UI Improvements][/b]

1. Gold requirements will now be displayed in choice-based events that require gold.

Well then, let's meet again soon in a better environment! You should come and see me quickly! 

[b]Love you all, MUAH! 😘💋💋[/b]
